Hi Andrew — attaching the draft artifacts for your review (see attachments). Short summary below and next steps.

Summary highlights:
- EU-only processing: We can operate your account under an "EU-only" hosting profile. When the account is configured to the EU-only profile and the DPA addendum is signed, all customer-controlled data (inputs, generated content, and logs) will be stored in our EU regions. Replication to non-EU regions will not occur unless explicitly enabled for cross-region DR — this is documented in the playbook.

- VPC/Connectivity: See the VPC-Runbook for three recommended architectures (Hosted Private Connector, VPC Peering via TGW, and On-prem Direct Connect patterns). The runbook includes network diagrams, example route tables, and allowed egress points. Our recommended default is VPC peering with strict egress allowlisting to reduce surface area.

- Cryptography & Key Management: KMS can be customer-managed (bring-your-own-KMS) for encryption-at-rest and for signing. If you require HSM-backed keys, we support that in Dedicated and Private deployments — the playbook clarifies tradeoffs.

- Data retention & logs: Standard retention for request/response logs is 90 days by default for hosted; retention is configurable down to 30 days for enterprise customers in Dedicated/Private. Audit logs and access traces are retained per the DPA addendum.

- Evidence bundle: SIG-Responses-Summary.xlsx maps CAIQ controls for regional/networking; where we map to SOC 2 artifacts we list the evidence id/reference. We’ve also included a one-page attestation (DPA addendum draft) for signature.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm if the default retention (90 days) is acceptable or list the required retention window.
2) If you want HSM/BYOK, let us know — that will route you to our Dedicated/Private options and may affect timeline.
3) If the artifacts look good we’ll attach the playbook + SIG mapping to the procurement packet and prepare the DPA addendum for DocuSign.

Attachments:
- Regional-Hosting-Playbook-v1.pdf (playbook with architecture diagrams and operational checklists)
- VPC-Runbook-v1.docx (network diagrams, sample route tables, egress allowlist examples)
- SIG-Responses-Summary.xlsx (CAIQ/SIG mapping and evidence pointers)
